current.service_desc:
Microsoft Azure Government is an open and flexible cloud platform that enables customers to quickly build, test, deploy, and manage their applications, services, and product development across a network of Microsoft-managed datacenters within the United States. The Microsoft Azure Government exports savings to the customer by delivering the software, platform, and information technology infrastructure resources where and when it is needed via the Internet. 

Microsoft Azure Government is used for building, deploying, and managing applications and services through a network of Microsoft-managed data centers. It provides Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and supports many different programming languages, tools, and frameworks, including both Microsoft-specific and third-party software and systems. The advantages of using Microsoft Azure Government include the ability to build large scalable applications serving large populations of users by scaling up or scaling down in relatively short periods of time.
Federal agencies interested in collaborative continuous monitoring with Microsoft should reach out to: AzureCollabConMon@microsoft.com

used_by.use: Hosting platform. AKS, Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Storage, Key Vault, Load Balancer, Private Link, NSGs, DDoS Protection, Backup, Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Sentinel (SIEM), Defender for Cloud and Endpoint, Entra ID, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure DNS.
AI model hosting for M-Files Aino and M-Files Agents.

Microsoft Azure Government, listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace as "Azure Government (includes Dynamics 365)" under provider Microsoft. Hosts the entire cloud service offering: compute, storage, identity, network, AI inference, secrets management, monitoring and physical infrastructure. Holds a FedRAMP High provisional authorization and is authorized for CUI under DFARS 252.204-7012. Physical, environmental and platform controls are inherited per Microsoft's published Customer Responsibility Matrix. Rohirrim operates a dedicated subscription isolated from any commercial Azure tenancy, with enclave-level segmentation, customer-managed secrets in Key Vault, encryption at rest and in transit, and independent monitoring through Microsoft Sentinel and Defender for Cloud.
Microsoft Azure Government (FedRAMP High) hosts the entire offering, including compute, storage, networking, GPU inference and Microsoft Entra ID for ioMoVo staff administration.
Microsoft Azure Government provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, platform services, identity services, and hosting environment supporting InEight Document US Government.

Microsoft Azure Government (FedRAMP High): all compute, storage, database, networking, key management, Azure OpenAI, email (Azure Communication Services), security monitoring and backup for ComplianceONE.
Microsoft Entra ID (via Azure Government) provides internal corporate single sign-on for personnel accessing VisualVault Cloud.

Azure Government provides the FedRAMP-authorized cloud infrastructure and platform services supporting Armada Platform, including AKS, Blob Storage, Container Registry, Firewall, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID/PIM, Sentinel, and related Azure services.

Azure Government IaaS and PaaS services including virtual networking, compute, storage, database services, identity services, security monitoring (Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor), key management (Key Vault), and supporting platform services.
Microsoft Azure Government provides the government-cloud hosting platform and underlying compute, networking, database, storage, messaging, identity, key-management, and related services used by AMS.
Microsoft Azure Government provides Azure OpenAI Service for the generative AI capabilities in eGain Knowledge+AI and eGain AI Agent, and provides authentication services for eGain Suite.
